comment: THE UNEXECUTABLE-INSTRUCTION FENCE baseline. A finding is an instruction with no receiver: (b, plan 00110) an agent body ORDERING the agent to execute JavaScript its own tools: grant gives it no way to run; (a, plan 00073) a src/commands recipe naming a task kind KINDS rejects (forward, HARD) or a KINDS kind no recipe documents (recipe-kind-reverse, debt-seeded — kinds like `sync` are enqueued programmatically and legitimately have no human-typed recipe); (c, plan 00073) a settings.yaml key generateSettings() writes into a new project that nothing in src/** reads. A CITATION IS NOT AN INVOCATION / A READ: a comment mention, a bare backticked name, a metavariable placeholder, and a same-name key on a DIFFERENT surface are NOT findings — the detector under-reports by design, exactly like src/lib/reachability.js. RATCHET: maxDebt may only ever be LOWERED and debt entries only ever REMOVED (correct the recipe, add the kind to KINDS, wire a reader, or stop writing the key). EXEMPTIONS ARE NOT DEBT: an exemption asserts the detector is WRONG, requires a written reason of at least 20 characters, and the list SHIPS EMPTY. The 15 seeded here are pre-existing debt surfaced by detections (a) and (c) landing: 8 task kinds with no human-typed recipe, and 7 settings.yaml keys written into every new project that no code reads (the real coverage floor lives in .ctoc/coverage-baseline.json, not quality.coverage_threshold).
